newsitem.title: USA: Goulds Pumps sets rights plan, part of ITT merger.
newsitem.headline: Goulds Pumps sets rights plan, part of ITT merger.

text.p: The board of directors of Goulds Pumps Inc said Monday it had adopted a stockholder protection rights agreement, which it will terminate immediately before the company is bought by ITT Industries Inc.
Earlier, the maker of centrifugal pumps and motors said it signed a definitive agreement to be bought by ITT Industries Inc for $37 a share or $815 million cash.
Under terms of the stockholder rights agreement, the company declared a dividend of one right for each outstanding share of Goulds common stock.
Goulds said the rights could be terminated before the plan's trigger point, if a person or group bought 20 percent or more of the outstanding shares of Goulds.

"In that regard, the company has agreed to terminate the rights immediately prior to ITT Industries' purchase of shares of Goulds Common Stock at $37.00 per share pursuant to the previously announced transaction," the company said in a statement.
The dividend will be paid on April 21, 1997 to stockholders of record on April 21, 1997.
